guide.kit.intro: Kit pads aren't host parameters: each pad stores a whole voice in the preset, and the kit bar edits them. These are the settings around them.
guide.kit.zone.value: MIDI {{low}}–{{high}} (Full keyboard plays the whole range)
guide.kit.level.value: A gain in dB stored with each pad; the factory kits set it so every pad plays at the same loudness.
